title: Lissity of explicit Frobenius saturation
statement: Let X be finite type over a finite field k, let v:D→Xbar be a clopen immersion, let V be an all-proetale native Weil sheaf with lisse carrier, and let M be a lisse adic sheaf on D. For every s:M→v^*(V.carrier), the explicit saturation of [def-zl-frobenius-saturation], using the adjunction v_!⊣v^*, has lisse carrier.

proof.text: Extension by zero across v agrees with finite etale direct image and is lisse. Frobenius pullback and its quasi-inverse preserve lissity, the latter by the canonical comparison of inverse equivalences.
